senses.en: unkind; lacking sympathy or generosity in judgment

example.en: It is uncharitable to judge her without knowing the facts.
example.zh: 不了解事实就评判她是不宽厚的。

senses.en: a building, usually with glass walls and a glass roof, used for growing plants; a greenhouse (British)

example.en: The seedlings grew in the glasshouse.
example.zh: 幼苗在温室里生长。

senses.en: the number of people who attend or take part in an event

example.en: The concert had a huge turnout despite the rain.
example.zh: 尽管下雨，音乐会的到场人数仍然很多。

senses.en: a widened section of a road where cars can stop or pass

example.en: Pull into the turnout and let the faster traffic pass.
example.zh: 驶入避车道，让较快的车辆先过。

senses.en: present or found everywhere
senses.zh: 无处不在的；十分普遍的

example.en: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
example.zh: 智能手机在现代生活中已无处不在。

senses.en: not official; not done with official approval

example.en: The unofficial results showed him leading the election.
example.zh: 非官方结果显示他在选举中领先。

senses.en: causing excitement or exhilaration, as if from alcohol
senses.zh: 令人兴奋的；使人陶醉的

example.en: She felt the heady excitement of her first trip abroad.
example.zh: 她感受到第一次出国的兴奋与陶醉。

senses.en: rash or impulsive; acting without careful thought

example.en: His heady decision to quit cost him dearly.
example.zh: 他冲动的辞职决定让他付出了沉重代价。

senses.en: a heavy load that must be carried

example.en: The porter set the heavy burden down beside the cart.
example.zh: 搬运工把沉重的担子放在手推车旁。

senses.en: a difficult responsibility or worry

example.en: The cost of care became a burden for the whole family.
example.zh: 照护费用成了全家的负担。

senses.en: to give someone a difficult responsibility or worry

example.en: She did not want to burden her friends with her problems.
example.zh: 她不想用自己的问题给朋友们添负担。

senses.en: famous or important; well known

example.en: She is a prominent scientist in the field of genetics.
example.zh: 她是遗传学领域一位著名的科学家。

senses.en: easily seen or noticeable

example.en: The notice was placed in a prominent position on the wall.
example.zh: 通知被贴在墙上的显眼位置。

senses.en: sticking out from a surface

example.en: He has prominent cheekbones.
example.zh: 他的颧骨很高。

senses.en: an area where direct light is blocked and it is darker and cooler

example.en: We sat in the shade of a large tree.
example.zh: 我们坐在一棵大树的阴凉处。

senses.en: a particular degree or variety of a color

example.en: She chose a lighter shade of blue for the walls.
example.zh: 她为墙壁选择了较浅的蓝色调。

senses.en: to protect something from direct light or heat

example.en: The awning shades the table from the afternoon sun.
example.zh: 遮阳篷为桌子遮挡午后的阳光。

senses.en: a part of a person, animal, or plant that performs a particular function

example.en: The heart is an important organ.
example.zh: 心脏是一个重要的器官。

senses.en: a keyboard musical instrument that produces sound using pipes or electronics

example.en: She plays the pipe organ in a church.
example.zh: 她在教堂里弹管风琴。

senses.en: a publication that represents the views of a party or organization

example.en: The newspaper is an official organ of the party.
example.zh: 这份报纸是该政党的机关报。

senses.en: a body or part of an organization that performs a particular function

example.en: The council is the organization's governing organ.
example.zh: 理事会是该组织的治理机构。

senses.en: fearless and willing to take risks

example.en: It was a bold decision to quit her job and start a business.
example.zh: 辞职创业是一个大胆的决定。

senses.en: written or drawn with thick, heavy lines

example.en: The heading is printed in bold type.
example.zh: 标题是用粗体字印刷的。

senses.en: a typeface style with thick, heavy lines

example.en: Use bold for the section titles.
example.zh: 章节标题请用粗体。

senses.en: a meeting of people, especially for a formal purpose

example.en: The whole school attended the morning assembly.
example.zh: 全校师生参加了晨会。

senses.en: the process of putting parts together to make something

example.en: The assembly of the bookshelf took about an hour.
example.zh: 组装这个书架花了大约一个小时。

senses.en: a legislative body, especially the lower house in some countries

example.en: The bill was passed by the state assembly.
example.zh: 该法案由州议会通过。

senses.en: facts, information, and skills gained through learning or experience

example.en: She has a good knowledge of local history.
example.zh: 她对当地历史有很好的了解。

senses.en: awareness or familiarity with a fact or situation

example.en: He denied any knowledge of the incident.
example.zh: 他否认知道那起事件。

senses.en: A person who trains and directs an athlete or a sports team.

example.en: The coach praised the team after the match.
example.zh: 比赛后，教练表扬了球队。

senses.en: To train or supervise someone, especially in sports.

example.en: She coaches young swimmers on weekends.
example.zh: 她周末指导年轻游泳运动员。

senses.en: A long-distance bus, especially in British English.
senses.zh: 长途汽车（尤用于英式英语）

example.en: We took a coach to the coast.
example.zh: 我们乘长途汽车去了海边。

senses.en: a religious song of praise, especially one sung in church

example.en: The congregation sang a hymn at the start of the service.
example.zh: 会众在礼拜开始时唱了一首赞美诗。

senses.en: to praise someone or something in a hymn or song of praise

example.en: The poet hymned the beauty of the countryside.
example.zh: 诗人歌颂了乡村的美景。

senses.en: paying close attention; listening or watching carefully

example.en: Please be attentive during the safety briefing.
example.zh: 安全简报期间请专心听讲。

senses.en: showing care for others' needs; considerate

example.en: The waiter was friendly and attentive.
example.zh: 这位服务员友好又周到。

senses.en: the force or process of pushing something forward

example.en: Jet engines provide powerful propulsion for aircraft.
example.zh: 喷气发动机为飞机提供强大的推进力。

senses.en: elegance and beauty of movement or manner

example.en: She moved across the stage with natural grace.
example.zh: 她以天生的优雅在舞台上移动。

senses.en: kindness or mercy shown to someone, especially when not deserved

example.en: The king pardoned him as an act of grace.
example.zh: 国王开恩赦免了他。

senses.en: a short prayer said before or after a meal

example.en: Grandfather always says grace before dinner.
example.zh: 爷爷总是在晚饭前做谢恩祷告。

senses.en: to make something more attractive or elegant; to honor a place with one's presence

example.en: A beautiful painting graces the hotel lobby.
example.zh: 一幅美丽的画为酒店大堂增色。

senses.en: done too quickly, without enough thought or care

example.en: Don't make a hasty decision before you hear all the facts.
example.zh: 在听取全部事实之前，不要仓促做决定。

senses.en: (of a person or action) rash; acting or deciding too quickly

example.en: It was hasty of him to quit his job after one bad day.
example.zh: 只因为糟糕的一天就辞职，他太草率了。

senses.en: silently bad-tempered and unfriendly

example.en: He stayed sullen all morning and refused to talk to anyone.
example.zh: 他一上午都闷闷不乐，不肯和任何人说话。

senses.en: (literary) gloomy or dark in appearance

example.en: The sky grew sullen as the storm approached.
example.zh: 暴风雨逼近时，天空变得阴沉。

senses.en: having bad luck; not lucky

example.en: He was unlucky and missed the last bus.
example.zh: 他很倒霉，错过了最后一班公交车。

senses.en: likely to bring bad luck

example.en: Some people think the number 13 is unlucky.
example.zh: 有些人认为数字13不吉利。

senses.en: able to be understood; clear

example.en: Her explanation was clear and intelligible to everyone.
example.zh: 她的解释清晰易懂，大家都听得明白。

senses.en: (of speech) clearly pronounced and easy to hear

example.en: The announcer spoke in an intelligible voice over the loudspeaker.
example.zh: 播音员通过扩音器用清晰的声音讲话。

senses.en: the group of people in a country or state who have the power to make laws

example.en: The state legislature passed a new tax law last month.
example.zh: 该州议会上个月通过了一项新的税收法。

senses.en: things that are thrown away; garbage

example.en: Please take out the trash before you leave.
example.zh: 你走之前请把垃圾拿出去。

senses.en: to throw something away; to damage or destroy something badly

example.en: The vandals trashed the empty building.
example.zh: 破坏者们把那栋空楼捣毁了。

senses.en: to imagine something as possible or expected in the future

example.en: She envisions a company where every employee feels valued.
example.zh: 她设想一家让每位员工都感到被重视的公司。

senses.en: an arrangement to pay for the temporary use of something such as a car, apartment, or equipment

example.en: We booked a car rental for our trip.
example.zh: 我们为旅行预订了租车服务。

senses.en: an amount of money paid for renting something; a rented property

example.en: The monthly rental for this apartment is quite high.
example.zh: 这套公寓的月租金相当高。

senses.en: relating to renting, or available to be rented

example.en: They live in a small rental apartment near the station.
example.zh: 他们住在车站附近一套小出租公寓里。

senses.en: a small printed piece of paper stuck on mail to show payment

example.en: I need a stamp for this letter.
example.zh: 我需要一张邮票寄这封信。

senses.en: a tool or mark used for printing words or designs

example.en: The customs officer put a stamp in my passport.
example.zh: 海关人员在我的护照上盖了章。

senses.en: to put a mark or design on something using a stamp

example.en: The clerk stamped the documents.
example.zh: 职员在文件上盖了章。

senses.en: to put your foot down heavily on the ground

example.en: He stamped his foot in anger.
example.zh: 他生气地跺了跺脚。

senses.en: having the same color or pattern; going well together

example.en: She wore a matching scarf with her coat.
example.zh: 她戴着与外套相配的围巾。

senses.en: relating to the land or territory of a country

example.en: The two countries signed a territorial agreement last year.
example.zh: 两国去年签署了一项领土协议。

senses.en: defending an area against others, as some animals do
senses.zh: （动物）有领地意识的；守卫领地的

example.en: Male robins are highly territorial during breeding season.
example.zh: 雄性知更鸟在繁殖季领地意识很强。

senses.en: in a way that only involves the surface; not deeply or thoroughly

example.en: The report superficially examined the causes of the problem.
example.zh: 这份报告对问题的成因只是浅尝辄止地分析了一下。

senses.en: farthest from the inside or center; most external
senses.zh: 最外面的；最远离中心的

example.en: The report includes an appendix on the outermost regions of the European Union.
example.zh: 该报告包含一个关于欧盟最边远地区的附录。

senses.en: the present day

example.en: Today is Monday.
example.zh: 今天是星期一。

senses.en: on this day

example.en: I have a meeting today.
example.zh: 我今天有个会议。

senses.en: the present time or period

example.en: Today's technology changes very fast.
example.zh: 当今的科技变化很快。

senses.en: at the present time; nowadays

example.en: Today, more people work from home.
example.zh: 如今，更多人在家工作。

senses.en: the activity of selling goods or services, or the total amount sold

example.en: Sales rose sharply last quarter.
example.zh: 上个季度销售额大幅增长。

senses.en: a period when goods are sold at lower prices

example.en: The winter sales start next week.
example.zh: 冬季减价活动下周开始。

senses.en: to travel on an animal, bicycle, or motorcycle, sitting on it and controlling it
senses.zh: 骑；乘（马、自行车、摩托车等）

example.en: She rides her bike to school every day.
example.zh: 她每天骑自行车去上学。

senses.en: to travel in a vehicle as a passenger

example.en: We rode the bus downtown.
example.zh: 我们乘公交车去了市中心。

senses.en: a journey in a vehicle, or a free trip given to someone

example.en: Can you give me a ride to the station?
example.zh: 你能让我搭个车去车站吗？

senses.en: a machine at an amusement park that people ride for fun

example.en: The roller coaster is the most popular ride in the park.
example.zh: 过山车是乐园里最受欢迎的游乐设施。

senses.en: connected in some way; having a relationship with something else

example.en: These two problems are closely related.
example.zh: 这两个问题密切相关。

senses.en: belonging to the same family
senses.zh: 有亲属关系的；有血缘关系的

example.en: She is related to me through my mother.
example.zh: 她和我有亲属关系，是通过我母亲那边的。

senses.en: extremely unpleasant or unacceptable
senses.zh: 令人厌恶的；使人反感的

example.en: Many people find cruelty to animals repugnant.
example.zh: 许多人认为虐待动物令人厌恶。

senses.en: allowing people to do as they like; not strict

example.en: His parents were permissive and rarely punished him.
example.zh: 他的父母很宽容，很少惩罚他。

senses.en: granting permission; allowing something by law or rule

example.en: The law is permissive rather than mandatory.
example.zh: 这项法律是许可性的而非强制性的。

senses.en: suggesting a good chance of success; favourable

example.en: They chose an auspicious date for the opening.
example.zh: 他们为开业选了个吉利的日子。

senses.en: relating to schools and education

example.en: Her scholastic achievements earned her a scholarship.
example.zh: 她的学业成绩为她赢得了奖学金。

senses.en: relating to medieval scholastic philosophy

example.en: Scholastic philosophers debated questions of faith and reason.
example.zh: 经院哲学家们辩论信仰与理性的问题。

senses.en: natural and unrefined; smelling or tasting of soil

example.en: The wine has an earthy flavor.
example.zh: 这种葡萄酒带有泥土的风味。

senses.en: an open insult or offensive act

example.en: Closing the old library was seen as an affront to the community.
example.zh: 关闭老图书馆被视为对社区的公然冒犯。

senses.en: to insult someone openly

example.en: His rude remarks affronted many guests.
example.zh: 他粗鲁的言论冒犯了许多客人。

senses.en: the act of noticing, listening to, or thinking carefully about something

example.en: The teacher asked for our attention before starting the lesson.
example.zh: 老师开始上课前要求我们注意听。

senses.en: special care or treatment given to someone or something

example.en: The patient needs medical attention.
example.zh: 这位病人需要医疗护理。

senses.en: a soldier's straight, silent standing position

example.en: The soldiers stood at attention while the officer entered.
example.zh: 军官进来时，士兵们立正站立。

senses.en: a command for soldiers to stand straight and silent

example.en: Attention! The general is arriving.
example.zh: 立正！将军到了。

senses.en: used by the speaker to refer to himself or herself as the object of a verb or preposition
senses.zh: 我自己（作宾语，指说话者本人）

example.en: I made myself a sandwich.
example.zh: 我给自己做了一个三明治。

senses.en: used to emphasize that the speaker personally does something
senses.zh: 我本人；我自己（用于强调）

example.en: I myself saw the accident.
example.zh: 我亲眼看到了那场事故。

senses.en: used after “by” to mean alone or without help from anyone else

example.en: I finished the project by myself.
example.zh: 我独自完成了这个项目。

senses.en: to go or come into a place

example.en: She entered the room quietly.
example.zh: 她悄悄地走进房间。

senses.en: to begin taking part in an activity or competition

example.en: He entered the writing contest last year.
example.zh: 他去年参加了写作比赛。

senses.en: to put information into a computer or form

example.en: Please enter your name in the box.
example.zh: 请在方框内输入你的姓名。

senses.en: to become involved in a field or situation

example.en: She entered politics after college.
example.zh: 她大学毕业后进入政界。

senses.en: a person who serves in an army

example.en: A young soldier guarded the entrance.
example.zh: 一名年轻士兵守卫着入口。

senses.en: to serve in an army as a soldier

example.en: He soldiered in the infantry for five years.
example.zh: 他在步兵部队服役了五年。

senses.en: to continue doing something despite difficulty

example.en: She soldiered on with the work despite her tiredness.
example.zh: 尽管很累，她还是坚持继续工作。

senses.en: a small hotel or pub offering lodging and food, often in the countryside
senses.zh: 小旅馆；客栈；（英式）酒馆旅店

example.en: We stayed at a cozy country inn for the night.
example.zh: 我们晚上住在一家温馨的乡村客栈。

senses.en: using, or ready to use, strong or forceful methods to achieve a goal

example.en: The union took a more militant stance during the negotiations.
example.zh: 工会在谈判期间采取了更强硬的立场。

senses.en: a person who uses aggressive or forceful methods, especially for a political cause

example.en: Police said the militants attacked the checkpoint before dawn.
example.zh: 警方称激进分子在黎明前袭击了检查站。

senses.en: magnificent and impressive; very beautiful

example.en: The palace has a splendid view of the mountains.
example.zh: 从这座宫殿可以看到群山的壮丽景色。

senses.en: excellent; very good

example.en: They did a splendid job on the project.
example.zh: 他们在这个项目上干得非常出色。

senses.en: to walk unsteadily as if about to fall

example.en: He got up and staggered to the door.
example.zh: 他站起来，摇摇晃晃地走向门口。

senses.en: to shock or surprise someone greatly

example.en: The news of her resignation staggered everyone.
example.zh: 她辞职的消息令所有人都震惊了。

senses.en: to arrange events or times so they do not happen together

example.en: The company staggers its employees' holidays.
example.zh: 公司错开安排员工的假期。

senses.en: an unsteady way of walking

example.en: He gave a stagger and nearly fell.
example.zh: 他踉跄了一下，差点摔倒。

senses.en: the rules for forming words and sentences in a language

example.en: Her English grammar is very good.
example.zh: 她的英语语法非常好。

senses.en: a book that describes the grammar of a language

example.en: He bought a Spanish grammar for his trip.
example.zh: 他为旅行买了一本西班牙语语法书。

senses.en: to treat someone in a way that lowers their dignity

example.en: He felt degraded by the insulting comments.
example.zh: 那些侮辱性的话让他感到被贬低了。

senses.en: to make something worse in quality

example.en: The oil is degraded by high temperatures.
example.zh: 高温会使油品变质。

senses.en: to break down chemically or naturally

example.en: Plastic takes years to degrade in soil.
example.zh: 塑料在土壤中需要多年才能降解。

senses.en: the amount of something produced by a person, machine, or factory

example.en: The factory increased its output by ten percent this year.
example.zh: 这家工厂今年产量提高了百分之十。

senses.en: information or data sent out from a computer or device

example.en: Check the printer's output for any errors.
example.zh: 检查打印机的输出是否有错误。

senses.en: to produce or send out data or goods

example.en: The system outputs the results in a simple table.
example.zh: 系统以简单的表格形式输出结果。

senses.en: an old object, such as furniture, that is valuable because of its age and rarity

example.en: She inherited an antique from her grandmother.
example.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一件古董。

senses.en: made long ago and valued for its age; old-fashioned

example.en: The room was furnished with antique furniture.
example.zh: 房间里摆放着古式家具。

senses.en: to make something look old or shop for antiques

example.en: They spent the afternoon antiquing in the old town.
example.zh: 他们下午在老城里逛古董店。

senses.en: the quality of being proud and behaving as if you are better than others

example.en: His arrogance made him few friends.
example.zh: 他的傲慢让他几乎没有朋友。

senses.en: a pleasant, noticeable smell, especially of food or drink

example.en: The aroma of fresh coffee filled the kitchen.
example.zh: 新鲜咖啡的香气弥漫着厨房。

senses.en: the basic unit of money in Japan

example.en: This meal cost about 1,000 yen.
example.zh: 这顿饭花了大约一千日元。

senses.en: a strong longing or desire for something

example.en: She felt a yen to travel abroad again.
example.zh: 她强烈渴望再次出国旅行。

senses.en: to long for something

example.en: After months in the city, he yenned for the quiet countryside.
example.zh: 在城里住了几个月后，他渴望宁静的乡村。

senses.en: morally right and just

example.en: He was respected as a righteous judge who never took bribes.
example.zh: 他作为一位从不受贿的正直法官而受人尊敬。

senses.en: (of anger or a cause) felt to be morally justified

example.en: His righteous indignation annoyed his colleagues.
example.zh: 他的义愤让同事们很反感。

senses.en: the state of being complete or whole

example.en: We can only understand the problem by considering its totality.
example.zh: 只有从整体上考虑，我们才能理解这个问题。

senses.en: the complete covering of the sun or moon in an eclipse

example.en: The totality lasted only a few minutes.
example.zh: 全食阶段只持续了几分钟。

senses.en: in a way that is suitable or appropriate

example.en: The bridge was aptly named the Gateway Bridge.
example.zh: 这座桥被恰当地命名为“大门桥”。

senses.en: a state of tiredness and lack of energy

example.en: The heat filled everyone with lethargy.
example.zh: 炎热让大家无精打采。

senses.en: attractive; charming

example.en: She looked fetching in her red dress.
example.zh: 她穿着红裙子显得很迷人。

senses.en: film on which documents are photographed at greatly reduced size for storage

example.en: Old newspapers are preserved on microfilm in the library.
example.zh: 旧报纸以缩微胶卷形式保存在图书馆里。

senses.en: to record documents on microfilm

example.en: The archive microfilmed all the manuscripts for preservation.
example.zh: 档案馆将所有手稿拍成缩微胶卷以便保存。

senses.en: a dog of mixed breed

example.en: Their mongrel is friendly and clever.
example.zh: 他们的混种狗又友好又聪明。

senses.en: the outer layer of the skin

example.en: The epidermis protects the body from the environment.
example.zh: 表皮保护身体免受外界影响。

senses.en: not genuine; pretending to be something it is not (often in combinations)
senses.zh: 假的；伪的（常用于复合词）

example.en: She hated his pseudo-intellectual style of talking.
example.zh: 她讨厌他那种伪知识分子式的说话风格。

senses.en: a person who pretends to be something they are not

example.en: Critics dismissed him as a pseudo pretending to understand art.
example.zh: 批评者说他是个假装懂艺术的冒牌货。

senses.en: a straight line joining two opposite corners of a shape

example.en: Draw a diagonal from one corner of the square to the opposite corner.
example.zh: 从正方形的一个角向对角画一条对角线。

senses.en: slanting; at an angle rather than straight across or up

example.en: She wore a scarf with diagonal stripes.
example.zh: 她戴了一条斜条纹的围巾。

senses.en: to officially approve a school, organization or program as meeting standards

example.en: The college is accredited by a national agency.
example.zh: 这所学院获得了全国性机构的认证。

senses.en: to officially recognize or credit someone with something

example.en: The award accredited him with the invention.
example.zh: 该奖项认定这项发明归功于他。

senses.en: a supply of something in excess, causing prices to fall

example.en: A glut of oil pushed prices down sharply.
example.zh: 石油供过于求使价格大幅下跌。

senses.en: to supply or fill with too much of something

example.en: Cheap imports glutted the market.
example.zh: 廉价进口商品充斥了市场。

senses.en: buildings where goods are manufactured

example.en: The city has many factories producing textiles.
example.zh: 这座城市有许多生产纺织品的工厂。
